runtime: Python agents on Azure Container Apps, Microsoft Foundry (Azure OpenAI) model deployment
orchestration_pattern: Blackboard shared state with sequential handoff and verifier gate
llm_policy: Model calls are reserved for key moments (goals, shots, cards, match phases) and recaps; every generated sentence passes the Grounding Verifier or is replaced by the pre-verified phrase bank.

agents.name: Ingest
agents.role: Writes each synthetic event to the shared blackboard and derives running match state (xG, shots, possession, pass streaks).

agents.name: Tactical Analyst
agents.role: Reads the recent event window: control vs chaos, defensive pressure, game rhythm, dominant side.

agents.name: Lead Commentator
agents.role: Live play-by-play in English, Italian, Spanish and German; analyst or fan voice; can take the side of the viewer's favourite club.
agents.model: Foundry deployment on key moments, phrase bank otherwise

agents.name: Narrator / Co-commentator
agents.role: Explains why the moment matters (xG context, pressing, possession streaks, cards) for the selected persona and language; voices the co-commentator line on big moments.

agents.name: Player Focus
agents.role: Tracks the viewer's chosen player across the match: distance, sprints, pass completion, involvement.

agents.name: Grounding Verifier
agents.role: Checks every number and player name in generated text against the event facts and blackboard; rejects goal calls without a goal; forces a deterministic fallback on failure.

agents.name: Broadcast
agents.role: Emits the machine-readable overlay (headline, narrative, commentary lines, evidence IDs, agent trace) over SSE; feeds Teams Adaptive Cards and Fabric exports.

agents.name: Recap Writer
agents.role: Writes the half-time and full-time report (xG verdict, key moments, player of the match) in the viewer's language and persona.
agents.model: Foundry deployment when configured, phrase bank otherwise
